patch_resolves_note: The fixed OVS patch removes UFID acceptance from parse_odp_key_mask_attr(), so the original PoC is guarded before nl_attr_get_size(mask). The adjacent genuine witness case set(skb_priority(0)) shows that when the fixed set-action path does execute the size calculation, maskbuf.size is already at least NLA_HDRLEN.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project-code statement on the vulnerable path that consumes the attacker-controlled set-action payload and routes it into the generic key/mask parser together with the stack-backed mask buffer.

The generic key/mask parser treats `ufid:` as a successful parse in every caller context and returns its length immediately, even though this path appends no key attribute to `actions` and no mask attribute to `maskbuf`.
MSAN crash site. nl_attr_get_size() reads the `nla_len` field from the caller-supplied pointer even though no struct nlattr header was ever written to the stack-backed `mask` buffer.
Intermediate runtime event mask_size_call materialized from verified transition assertion A-EMPTY-MASK-TO-SINK.

edges.description: The same empty maskbuf.size state returned to parse_odp_action after parse_odp_key_mask_attr() is carried unchanged to the later nl_attr_get_size(mask) call that triggers MSAN.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records set_post_parse.maskbuf_size == mask_size_call.maskbuf_size == 0.
